title: configfile repository settings
description: configfile.repository.json, at the root of a dotfiles repository: settings of the repository itself, the same on every machine. See https://docs.configfile.sh/reference/modules/#repository-settings

$schema.description: The JSON Schema of this file, for editor completion and validation. configfile only checks that it is text.

module_settings.description: The name of the settings file of each module, in its folder. Default: configfile.module.json. configfile 1.x used settings.json.
